response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development experience with exposure to geospatial data (GISCollective) and performance-critical systems (Sociomantic). However, his recent work lacks deep C++/Rust focus or direct routing/navigation pipeline experience, which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience with geospatial data platforms (GISCollective) and open-source contributions in the domain.
Proven track record in optimizing systems for scale and performance (e.g., low-latency apps at Sociomantic).
Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on experimentation (e.g., workshops, TDD, and functional programming).
concerns: Primary expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js, with limited recent C++/Rust experience (last noted in 2018–2020).
No direct experience with routing/navigation pipelines or real-time traffic integration.
Current role (re:cinq) is heavily AI-focused, diverging from geospatial/routing priorities.
